findings.message: slide 7 ('Communication Transports: Stdio vs WebSockets and HTTP'): [fact] The slide title and speaker notes mention WebSockets as a transport mechanism, but the MCP specification (as of protocol version 2024-11-05) defines only two transports: stdio and HTTP with Server-Sent Events (SSE). WebSockets are not part of the standard. Fix: Change the title to 'Communication Transports: Stdio and HTTP+SSE' and update the notes to state that MCP supports stdio for local servers and HTTP with Server-Sent Events for remote servers; remove any reference to WebSockets.
